[Intro]
[Am]

[Verse 1]
[Am]Wine is fine, but whis-
key's quicker
Suicide is slow
with liquor
Take a bottle and drown
your sorrows
Then it floods away
[G]tomorrows

[Break]
[Am]
Away tomor-
rows

[Verse 2]
[Am]Evil thoughts and e-
vil doings
Cold, alone you hang
in ruins
Thought that you'd escape
The Reaper
You can't escape the Mas-
ter [G]Keeper

[Chorus]
[Bm]'Cause you feel life's un-
real and you're living a lie
Such a shame who's to
blame and you're wondering why
Then you ask from your
cask is there life after birth
What you saw can be
Hell on this earth,

[Break]
[Am]
Hell on this earth

[Verse 3]
[Am]Now you live inside
a bottle
The Reaper's traveling at
full throttle
It's catching you but you
don't see
The Reaper's you and The
Reaper is [G]me

[Chorus]
[Bm]Breaking laws, knocking
doors, but there's no one at home
Made your bed, rest your
head, but you lie there and moan
Where to hide, Sui-
cide is the only way out
Don't you know what it's
really about

[Break]
[Am]

[Bridge]
[Am]

[Interlude]
[Am]

[Verse 4]
[Am]Wine is fine, but whis-
key's quicker
Suicide is slow
with liquor
Take a bottle, drown
your sorrows
Then it floods away
[G]tomorrows

[Break]
[Am]
Take me away,
tomor-
row
It's never gettin' fixed,
no flaps, nobody,
no [G]flaps, nothing?

[Outro]
[Am]
title: Suicide Solution
tuning: E A D G B E
